text:
emma: morning async — quick check on the Embedding Cache launch swimlane. what I did: finalized canary test plan, updated spec with fallback behavior. blockers: still waiting on ops for the cert rotation window. today: finish QA ticket assign and open any final PRs

raj: pushed PR #4123 that wires the cache invalidation TTL, needs a review from eng-runtime. small change but affects hot path. tagging @lynne for perf comments

lynne: I'll take a look at #4123 this afternoon. quick note — the TTL logic looks fine but we need to gate it behind the feature flag until we confirm hit rates in canary. can we add a toggle?

mike: added the feature flag in a follow-up commit, see branch embed/ttl-flag. also updated the console flags UI with a default off state. deploy-bot: staged canary with 2 replicas in us-west-2 (replicas=2, qps cap=250)

selena: QA report from last night: two flaky tests in the rerank pipeline when cache misses spike. filing INF-789 with logs and stack traces. repro steps included

emma: thanks @selena — can you attach the repro curl + minimal dataset in INF-789? that'll speed up root cause. also tag @mike on the ticket once attached

raj: question for product — if we see cache miss storm, do we prefer graceful degradation to smaller model (latency-safe) or rate-limit upstream calls? need policy to put in spec

emma: prefer degrade to smaller model first for UX (most users still get answers) but fallback to rate-limit if downstream cost exceeds spend guard. adding decision to spec under "graceful degradation"

lynne: perf note: downgrading model increases token latency but keeps p99 under SLA in our sim. we'll add perf numbers to the spec table (p50/p95/p99 for both models)

mike: code review ping @lynne @raj on #4123 and #4128 (flag + console). aim to merge by EOD to start canary tomorrow

selena: QA will prioritize the flaky tests after INF-789 is populated. estimate 4 hours to full regression run

emma: blockers recap: ops cert rotation window (ops @raj? can you confirm time), INF-789 repro needed, reviews on #4123/#4128. if we clear these, target canary deploy tomorrow morning PST

raj: ops cert rotation confirmed for 02:00 UTC tomorrow, should be fine for canary after 03:00 UTC. I'll coordinate with infra.

mike: noted, will schedule the merge and canary after 03:30 UTC to be safe

emma: thanks everyone. action items: mike -> merge + schedule canary, lynne -> perf numbers in spec, selena -> INF-789 repro, raj -> ops coordination. shout if anything blocks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: reminder — runway alert: dedicated cluster in us-west-2 at 72% GPU utilization. consider scaling policy for peak canary

emma: added scaling note to runbook. closing this thread, will post a short follow-up once canary is green.
